QuestInfo.name: [Root Abyss Daily] Rose Red
QuestInfo.1: Paint 5 blue and purple roses at the South Garden in red. It's a crummy job, but you gotta do what you gotta do.\n\n(This quest can be done in both #r<Normal Mode> and <Hard Mode>#k.)

0.0: Hoink! I take care of the Crimson Queen's South Garden.
0.1: The Queen really loves red roses, but only blue and purple roses bloom in the South Garden. Will ya help me out?

yes.1: The Queen will be so happy when she sees all the red roses in the garden!
yes.0: I think you could just paint #b5#k of the blue or purple roses red for today.

no.0: The Queen may eat me alive if she gets upset. You shouldn't ignore a lady's request...
